name: 61548 · Metamora, IL
findings: ZIP 61548 (Metamora) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 61548 (Metamora) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 61548 (Metamora) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
